## Quick Answer

**Pipedrive 9.4/10** — Pipedrive is the most focused and effective sales pipeline CRM in 2026, purpose-built for small business owners, sales teams, and freelancers who want to close more deals without drowning in complexity. With a visual Kanban-style pipeline, built-in LeadBooster chatbot and web forms, Smart Contact Data enrichment, 400+ integrations, and a new AI Sales Assistant, Pipedrive does one thing exceptionally well: it helps you track, manage, and close deals. Paid plans start at just **$14/user/month** (Essential) and scale to **$99/user/month** (Enterprise). The trade-off: it is a sales-first tool — if you need deep marketing automation or full project management, you will need integrations.

## What We Like

- **Pipeline-first design** — Pipedrive's visual Kanban pipeline is the gold standard for deal tracking in the CRM space. Drag-and-drop deal movement, customizable stages, and real-time updates make it dead simple to see exactly where every deal stands. You can have multiple pipelines for different sales processes (inbound, outbound, recurring revenue, partner sales) — each with its own stages and fields.
- **Exceptional ease of use** — Most sales teams can be fully productive within an hour. The interface is clean, intuitive, and avoids the feature bloat that plagues platforms like Salesforce and HubSpot. There is no steep learning curve — just pipelines, contacts, activities, and reports.
- **LeadBooster is genuinely useful** — The built-in LeadBooster add-on ($32.50/month per company) includes a website chatbot (proactive chat with customizable flows), web forms that auto-create leads, a meeting scheduler, and live chat. It is a lightweight alternative to dedicated tools like Intercom or Drift without the $100+/month price tag.
- **Smart Contact Data enrichment** — Automatically enrich your contacts with company information, job titles, social profiles, and industry data from over 200 million companies. Saves hours of manual data entry and keeps your CRM clean.
- **Powerful email sync** — Two-way sync with Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook 365, and Outlook.com. Emails are automatically linked to contacts and deals, and the sync is bidirectional — send from Pipedrive and it appears in your sent folder, or from Gmail and it appears in Pipedrive. The inline composer and templates make it easy to send tracked emails with open and click notifications.
- **AI Sales Assistant** — Pipedrive's AI layer (launched in 2025 and significantly improved in 2026) provides smart activity suggestions, automated follow-up reminders, deal risk scoring, and email reply drafting. It flags deals that have gone quiet for more than 7 days, suggests the best time to reach out based on past engagement patterns, and auto-generates weekly sales summaries.
- **400+ integrations** — Native integrations with Zapier, Mailchimp, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Trello, Slack, QuickBooks, Xero, PandaDoc, DocuSign, and hundreds more. The Pipedrive Marketplace makes discovering and installing integrations effortless.
- **Mobile app is excellent** — The iOS and Android apps offer near-full parity with the web experience. You can move deals between stages, log calls, schedule activities, send emails, check reports, and use the full pipeline view. Offline mode syncs changes when you reconnect. Notifications are configurable and not overly noisy.

## What Could Be Better

- **Limited marketing automation** — Pipedrive is a sales CRM first. Native marketing automation is basic: you can send bulk emails via Campaigns (add-on), but you won't find sophisticated email sequences, lead scoring based on website behavior, or A/B testing without integrations. For full-funnel marketing automation, HubSpot or ActiveCampaign are better fits.
- **No native document generation** — While Pipedrive integrates with PandaDoc, DocuSign, and SignNow for contracts and proposals, there is no built-in quote or proposal builder. Small teams working on tight budgets may find this gap frustrating.
- **Reporting is powerful but not best-in-class** — The reporting dashboard in Professional and Enterprise plans is solid: deal conversion reports, activity reports, revenue forecasting, and custom dashboards. But it lacks the advanced analytics and predictive modeling of Salesforce or the visual polish of HubSpot's dashboards.
- **Enterprise features lag behind Salesforce** — At $99/user/month, the Enterprise plan is competitive but does not match Salesforce's depth in territory management, advanced permissions, or customization. Large organizations with complex sales structures may still need Salesforce.
- **Storage limits on lower plans** — Essential gives only 5GB storage per company; Advanced bumps to 10GB. For teams that handle many documents and attachments directly in the CRM, this fills up fast. Professional starts at 25GB, and Enterprise is unlimited.

## In-Depth Features

### Pipeline & Deal Management

Pipedrive's pipeline management is the core of the product and arguably the best in the CRM industry for SMBs. Every deal lives on a visual Kanban board that you can customize with any number of stages (most teams use 4-8 stages like "Lead Contacted," "Meeting Scheduled," "Proposal Sent," "Negotiation," "Closed Won/Lost").

Each deal card shows: deal value, expected close date, contact person, organization, and a progress bar. You can drag deals between stages, and the system automatically logs the amount of time each deal spends in each stage — a metric Pipedrive calls "velocity." High velocity means your team is moving deals fast; low velocity reveals bottlenecks in specific stages.

Key deal management features:
- **Multiple pipelines** — Create separate pipelines for different sales workflows (inbound, outbound, partner sales, recurring subscriptions). Each pipeline can have its own stages, probability percentages, and fields. Users can switch between pipelines with one click.
- **Deal rotation and round-robin** — Automatically assign incoming leads to team members based on round-robin or least-recently-assigned rules (Advanced and up).
- **Activities and reminders** — Each deal can have scheduled activities (calls, emails, meetings, tasks) with automatic reminders. The activity timeline on each deal shows the full interaction history.
- **Email tracking** — When you send an email from Pipedrive or via the Gmail/Outlook integration, you get real-time notifications when the recipient opens the email or clicks a link. Email opens are tracked via a tracking pixel; clicks via link wrapping.
- **Deal notes and attachments** — Rich text notes with @mentions, file uploads up to the plan storage limit, and the ability to add inline images directly.
- **Expected close dates** — Every deal has an expected close date field. Pipedrive's forecasting uses these to predict revenue by month, quarter, or custom date range.
- **Lost deal analysis** — When you mark a deal as lost, you can select a reason (price, competitor, timing, no decision, etc.) — giving you data to analyze why deals slip away. Pipedrive tracks lost deal percentages per stage and per reason.

### LeadBooster

LeadBooster is Pipedrive's lead generation and capture toolkit, available as an add-on for $32.50/month per company. It bundles four tools:

**1. Chatbot:** An automated chatbot that engages website visitors with pre-built conversational flows. You can customize greetings, ask qualifying questions, capture contact details, and route warm leads to the right team member. The chatbot learns from common questions and can handle basic FAQs without human intervention.

**2. Live Chat:** When a visitor needs a human, the chatbot seamlessly escalates to live chat. Team members receive desktop and mobile notifications and can respond from the Pipedrive interface. Chat transcripts are automatically attached to the contact's timeline.

**3. Web Forms:** Drag-and-drop form builder for embedding on landing pages, blog posts, or as pop-ups. Forms auto-create contacts and deals in Pipedrive. You can use conditional logic to show/hide fields based on previous answers.

**4. Meeting Scheduler:** A Calendly-style booking widget that syncs with your Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar. Prospects pick from your available time slots; the booking automatically creates a contact, deal, and calendar event in Pipedrive.

LeadBooster is not as powerful as dedicated solutions like Intercom ($74+/month) or Drift ($400+/month), but for small to mid-size sales teams, it is a remarkably capable all-in-one tool at a fraction of the price.

### Smart Contact Data

Pipedrive's Smart Contact Data (starting at $15/month per company) automatically enriches your contacts with business intelligence from Pipedrive's database of over 200 million companies. When you add a new contact email, Pipedrive can automatically populate:

- Company name, size, industry, and location
- Contact job title and seniority level
- LinkedIn profile URL
- Company phone number and website
- Annual revenue range and funding information
- Technologies used (CRM, marketing tools, analytics, etc.)

This enrichment happens in real-time as you add contacts or import lists. It reduces manual data entry by an estimated 80% and ensures your CRM never has stale contact records.

### AI Sales Assistant

Pipedrive's AI Sales Assistant (included in Professional and Enterprise plans) is the newest major feature and received significant upgrades in early 2026. It uses machine learning to:

- **Score deal risk** — Analyzes deal age, activity frequency, email engagement, and stage duration to flag deals at risk of stalling or loss. Deals with no activity for 7+ days are automatically highlighted.
- **Recommend next steps** — Based on historical patterns of won/lost deals, the AI suggests the optimal next action (send a follow-up email, schedule a call, prepare a proposal). For example: "Deals in the 'Proposal Sent' stage that receive a follow-up call within 3 days have a 38% higher win rate — schedule a call with this contact."
- **Draft email replies** — When you open an email thread, the AI can generate a context-aware draft reply based on the conversation history. You can edit before sending.
- **Generate weekly sales summaries** — Auto-creates a summary of deals won, deals lost, new leads added, activities completed, and revenue forecast vs actuals. Managers can share these with stakeholders in one click.
- **Identify best times to contact** — Analyzes past email open and reply patterns to suggest the optimal time of day and day of week to reach each contact.

Pipedrive's AI is more narrowly focused than Salesforce's Einstein or HubSpot's Breeze AI, but that focus is a strength — it provides actionable sales-specific insights without the noise of general-purpose AI assistants.

### Email Sync & Communication

Email syncing is one of Pipedrive's strongest features. The two-way sync works with:
- **Gmail & Google Workspace** (via browser extension)
- **Microsoft Outlook 365 & Outlook.com** (via browser extension or add-in)
- **Exchange** (via IMAP/SMTP)

Once connected, every email sent to or from a contact linked in Pipedrive is automatically attached to that contact and its associated deals. You can compose, send, and track emails directly from Pipedrive's interface. Email templates save time on common replies (proposal follow-ups, meeting confirmations, thank-you notes).

The email tracking feature is invisible to recipients — a small tracking pixel detects opens, and link wrapping tracks clicks. You see a timeline of every open and click per email right on the deal page.

**Activities logging** is equally robust: calls logged via the mobile app are linked to contacts and deals automatically. You can log call duration, add notes, and set follow-up activities. The activity timeline on each contact gives you a complete interaction history at a glance.

### Customization

Pipedrive offers strong customization for a sales-focused CRM:

- **Custom fields** — Add any field type to deals, contacts, organizations, products, or activities: text, number, currency, date, date/time, phone, email, URL, dropdown (single or multi-select), checkbox, percentage, and more.
- **Custom pipelines** — Create unlimited pipelines with custom stages. Each stage can have a probability percentage that feeds into revenue forecasting.
- **Workflow automations** — Visual "if-this-then-that" style automations. Triggers include: deal stage changed, contact created, email received, activity completed, goal met. Actions include: update field, send email, create activity, assign user, add follower, trigger webhook. Advanced and higher plans include unlimited automations.
- **Permission profiles** — Set granular permissions per user or role: view-only, edit, or admin access to deals, contacts, pipelines, reports, and settings. Enterprise adds custom permission profiles.
- **Templates** — Save deal templates with pre-populated fields, stages, activities, and products for recurring deal types.

### Reporting & Analytics

Pipedrive's reporting capabilities vary by plan:

**Essential & Advanced:** Basic dashboards with deal counts, revenue totals, activity summaries, and pipeline value charts. You get a predefined dashboard and limited customization.

**Professional & Enterprise:** Full custom reporting dashboard builder. Create unlimited dashboards with:
- **Revenue forecasting** — Predicts future revenue based on deal values, stage probabilities, and expected close dates. View by month, quarter, or custom range.
- **Deal conversion reports** — Funnel analysis showing how many deals enter each stage and what percentage convert to won.
- **Activity reports** — Track calls made, emails sent, meetings held per user. Compare activity volume against closed deals.
- **Goal tracking** — Set monthly/quarterly revenue goals and track progress against them in real-time. Goals can be set per user, team, or company.
- **Lost deal analysis** — See why deals are lost (by reason, stage, user, or time period).
- **Sales velocity** — Measure the average time deals spend in each stage and identify bottlenecks.
- **User performance** — Compare individual performance metrics side-by-side.

Reports can be exported as CSV or PDF. Professional and Enterprise plans also include a public API for building custom reports in third-party BI tools like Tableau or Power BI.

### Mobile App

The Pipedrive mobile app (iOS and Android) is one of the best CRM mobile experiences available. Key features:
- Full pipeline view with drag-and-drop deal movement
- Contact management with full history and activity timeline
- Email compose and send (with templates)
- Call logging (auto-detects calls from your phone log)
- Activity creation and completion
- Reporting dashboards (view-only on mobile)
- Push notifications for deal updates, activity reminders, and email opens
- Offline mode: view and edit data without connection; changes sync automatically when reconnected
- Widget support for iOS (today view quick stats) and Android (home screen pipeline snapshot)

The mobile experience is stellar — it covers nearly all features available on desktop. The only missing pieces are admin settings (user management, billing) and the advanced custom report builder.

### Integrations

With 400+ native integrations in the Pipedrive Marketplace, you can connect Pipedrive to virtually every tool in your tech stack. Key integrations:

- **Productivity:** Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Trello, Zapier, Make (Integromat)
- **Marketing:** Mailchimp, Constant Contact, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Google Ads, Facebook Ads
- **Accounting:** QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks
- **E-signature:** DocuSign, PandaDoc, SignNow
- **Customer support:** Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau
- **Communication:** Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams

Zapier integration alone unlocks 5,000+ app connections. For custom integrations, Pipedrive offers a RESTful API and webhooks.

**Pipedrive vs HubSpot Sales Hub:** HubSpot offers a broader ecosystem with native marketing, sales, and service hubs. But HubSpot Sales Professional at $90/user/month is nearly double Pipedrive Professional at $49/user/month. If you need a full CRM suite with built-in marketing automation and CMS, HubSpot is worth the premium. If you just want to manage your sales pipeline effectively, Pipedrive provides 90% of the functionality at 55% of the cost.

**Pipedrive vs Zoho CRM:** Zoho is cheaper at the Standard tier ($20/user/mo) and includes marketing automation, but its pipeline interface is less intuitive and the learning curve is steeper. Zoho also offers more modules (inventory, email marketing, desk) in one ecosystem. Pipedrive wins on pipeline-centric design and ease of use. Choose Zoho if you want a broader feature set at a lower price and have time to learn the system. Choose Pipedrive if you want your team selling in hours, not weeks.

**Pipedrive vs Salesforce:** Salesforce is the enterprise standard with unmatched customization, but it requires dedicated administration and often a consultant to set up properly. The Sales Professional plan starts at $80/user/month and still needs add-ons for many features Pipedrive includes natively. Pipedrive is better for small-to-mid-size teams that want a CRM that works out of the box. Salesforce is better for large organizations with complex sales processes and dedicated CRM admin resources.

**Pipedrive vs Freshsales:** Freshsales (now part of Freshworks) is the closest direct competitor at a similar price point. Freshsales Growth at $18/user/month includes built-in phone, email, and contact scoring — features Pipedrive offers as add-ons. Pipedrive's pipeline management is more visual and intuitive, and its mobile app is significantly better. Both are excellent options; choose Pipedrive for superior pipeline management and mobile experience; choose Freshsales for better built-in marketing automation and built-in phone capabilities.

## Who Should Use Pipedrive?

**Best for:**
- **Small business owners** — If you are running a team of 2-20 salespeople and need a CRM that your team will actually use (not one that collects dust), Pipedrive is the best option. Its low learning curve means rapid adoption.
- **Sales teams that live in their pipeline** — If your daily workflow revolves around moving deals through stages, scheduling follow-ups, and tracking email engagement, Pipedrive's pipeline-first design will feel like home.
- **Freelancers and solopreneurs** — The Essential plan at $14/user/month is affordable, and you get a full-featured CRM without paying for marketing or service modules you do not need.
- **Real estate agents and brokers** — The visual pipeline maps naturally to property stages (listing, showing, offer, under contract, closed). Custom fields for property details and integration with DocuSign make it a popular choice.
- **B2B service providers** — Agencies, consultancies, SaaS companies, and professional services firms benefit from Pipedrive's deal tracking, activity logging, and email sync for tracking long B2B sales cycles.
- **Startups scaling their sales function** — Pipedrive grows with you from a team of 5 to 50+. The Enterprise tier adds SSO, advanced permissions, and dedicated support when you need it.

**Not ideal for:**
- **Enterprise sales orgs with complex territory management** — Salesforce's territory management, opportunity splits, and multi-layer approval workflows are still unmatched. Pipedrive keeps things simpler.
- **Teams that need native marketing automation** — Pipedrive's Campaigns add-on handles bulk email but cannot match HubSpot or ActiveCampaign's automation sequences, lead scoring, or A/B testing. Pair Pipedrive with ActiveCampaign or Mailchimp if you need both.
- **Businesses that require native CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote)** — If you need complex quoting with product bundles, discount approvals, and tiered pricing, you will want Salesforce CPQ or HubSpot CPQ. Pipedrive relies on e-signature integrations.
- **Non-sales departments** — Pipedrive is purpose-built for sales. Customer support teams should use Freshdesk or Zendesk; project teams should use ClickUp or Asana; marketing teams need dedicated marketing tools.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I import data from other CRMs like Salesforce or HubSpot?

Yes. Pipedrive provides native import tools for CSV and Excel files, and direct import templates specifically designed for Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho CRM. The import wizard maps your fields to Pipedrive's fields with a preview step to verify accuracy. For advanced migration, Pipedrive's API and professional services (Enterprise plan) can handle custom data migrations. Most imports take 30-60 minutes for up to 10,000 records.

### Does Pipedrive integrate with Gmail and Outlook?

Yes — and it is one of Pipedrive's best features. The Pipedrive for Gmail extension (Chrome) and Pipedrive for Outlook add-in provide two-way email sync, email tracking (open and click notifications), and the ability to create contacts and deals directly from your inbox. The sync is bidirectional: emails sent from Pipedrive appear in your Gmail/Outlook Sent folder and vice versa. The integration works with Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook 365, Outlook.com, and Exchange.

### What AI features does Pipedrive offer?

Pipedrive's AI Sales Assistant (Professional and Enterprise plans) offers: deal risk scoring to flag stalled deals, next-step recommendations based on historical win patterns, AI-powered email reply drafting, automated weekly sales summaries for managers, and optimal contact time suggestions based on engagement history. The AI is purpose-built for sales workflows — practical and actionable rather than flashy.

### Is there a free plan or free trial?

Pipedrive does not offer a permanent free plan, but it provides a **14-day free trial** with full access to the plan you want to evaluate (Essential, Advanced, or Professional). No credit card is required for the trial. After the trial, you choose a plan. There is no free tier equivalent to HubSpot Free CRM or Zoho CRM Free Edition.

### Does Pipedrive have a mobile app?

Yes — and it is excellent. The Pipedrive mobile app is available on both iOS and Android and offers near-full parity with the web version. You can view and move deals through pipelines, manage contacts, log calls (with automatic call detection), send and track emails, schedule activities, view reports, and receive push notifications. Offline mode lets you access and edit data without an internet connection — changes sync automatically when you reconnect.

### Can I track emails and see when someone opens them?

Yes. Pipedrive's email tracking feature sends you real-time notifications when a recipient opens your email or clicks a link. Opens are tracked via an invisible tracking pixel; link clicks are tracked via link wrapping. You can see the full email engagement history on each deal and contact page — including how many times an email was opened and which links were clicked.

### Is Pipedrive secure and GDPR compliant?

Yes. Pipedrive is SOC 2 Type II certified and fully GDPR compliant. Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Pipedrive stores data in Google Cloud Platform data centers with locations in the US and EU (you can select your data residency region). Enterprise plans add SSO/SAML, advanced permissions, audit logs, and custom data retention policies. Pipedrive also offers Data Processing Addendums (DPA) for GDPR compliance.

### How does Pipedrive's pricing compare to HubSpot and Salesforce?

Pipedrive is significantly more affordable. Pipedrive Professional costs **$49/user/month** (annual billing). HubSpot Sales Hub Professional costs **$90/user/month** — nearly double. Salesforce Sales Professional costs **$80/user/month**. Even Pipedrive Enterprise at **$99/user/month** is comparable to HubSpot and Salesforce's mid-tier plans. For a 10-person sales team, switching from HubSpot Pro to Pipedrive Pro would save over $4,900/year.

### Does Pipedrive support multiple currencies and languages?

Yes. Pipedrive supports over 15 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, and more. The interface language can be set per user. For currencies, you can set deals in any currency, and Pipedrive converts them to your base currency for reporting. Each deal can have its own currency setting independent of other deals.

### Can I automate workflows and repetitive tasks?

Yes. Pipedrive's workflow automation tool (Advanced and higher plans) uses a visual builder to create "if-this-then-that" rules. For example: "When a deal moves to 'Proposal Sent' stage, send a follow-up email to the contact and create a task to call in 3 days." You can trigger automations on deal stage changes, contact creation, email events, activity completions, and goal milestones. Advanced plans include up to 10 active automations; Professional and Enterprise have unlimited automations.

### What is LeadBooster and do I need it?

LeadBooster is a paid add-on ($32.50/month per company) that bundles a website chatbot, live chat, customizable web forms, and a meeting scheduler. It turns your website into a lead generation machine and captures contacts directly into Pipedrive. If you rely on your website for inbound leads and want to reduce response time (chat converts 3x better than forms), LeadBooster is a worthwhile investment. If you already use Intercom, Drift, or a dedicated form tool like Typeform, you may not need it.

### Does Pipedrive offer a meeting scheduler?

Yes — LeadBooster includes a built-in meeting scheduler that syncs with your Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar. Prospects can view your available time slots and book meetings directly. The scheduler automatically creates a new deal and contact in Pipedrive and adds the event to your calendar. If you do not want the full LeadBooster add-on, the Advanced plan includes a standalone meeting scheduler.

---

## Conclusion

**Pipedrive remains the best sales CRM for small to mid-size businesses that want to close more deals without CRM fatigue.** It does not try to be everything to everyone — it focuses relentlessly on what matters most: pipeline management, deal tracking, and sales communication. The visual Kanban interface gets out of your way, the email sync keeps your communication history complete, and the AI Sales Assistant provides genuinely helpful nudges without adding noise.

At **$14-$99/user/month**, Pipedrive offers exceptional value for sales teams. The Professional plan at **$49/user/month** is the sweet spot, giving you AI, forecasting, custom reports, and unlimited automations at half the price of HubSpot's comparable tier.

If you are evaluating CRMs in 2026 and your primary need is a tool that your sales team will actually open every day, Pipedrive is the safest bet on the market. It may not have the marketing automation of HubSpot or the enterprise depth of Salesforce, but for closing more deals, nothing beats Pipedrive's pipeline-first approach.

schema.description: Pipedrive is the most focused and effective sales pipeline CRM in 2026, purpose-built for small business owners, sales teams, and freelancers who want to close more deals. Our comprehensive review covers pricing, features, AI Sales Assistant, LeadBooster, and how it stacks up against HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and Freshsales.

mainEntity.name: Can I import data from other CRMs like Salesforce or HubSpot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pipedrive provides native import tools for CSV and Excel files, and direct import templates designed for Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho CRM. The import wizard maps your fields to Pipedrive's fields with a preview step. For advanced migration, Pipedrive's API and professional services (Enterprise plan) can handle custom data migrations. Most imports take 30-60 minutes for up to 10,000 records.

mainEntity.name: Does Pipedrive integrate with Gmail and Outlook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Pipedrive for Gmail extension (Chrome) and Pipedrive for Outlook add-in provide two-way email sync, email tracking (open and click notifications), and the ability to create contacts and deals directly from your inbox. The sync is bidirectional — emails sent from Pipedrive appear in your Gmail/Outlook Sent folder and vice versa. It works with Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook 365, Outlook.com, and Exchange.

mainEntity.name: What AI features does Pipedrive offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pipedrive's AI Sales Assistant (Professional and Enterprise plans) offers: deal risk scoring to flag stalled deals, next-step recommendations based on historical win patterns, AI-powered email reply drafting, automated weekly sales summaries for managers, and optimal contact time suggestions based on engagement history. The AI is purpose-built for sales workflows and provides practical, actionable insights.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free plan or free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pipedrive does not offer a permanent free plan, but it provides a 14-day free trial with full access to the plan you want to evaluate (Essential, Advanced, or Professional). No credit card is required for the trial. There is no free tier equivalent to HubSpot Free CRM or Zoho CRM Free Edition.

mainEntity.name: Does Pipedrive have a mobile app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — and it is excellent. The Pipedrive mobile app is available on both iOS and Android and offers near-full parity with the web version. You can view and move deals through pipelines, manage contacts, log calls (with automatic call detection), send and track emails, schedule activities, view reports, and receive push notifications. Offline mode lets you access and edit data without an internet connection.

mainEntity.name: Can I track emails and see when someone opens them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pipedrive's email tracking feature sends you real-time notifications when a recipient opens your email or clicks a link. Opens are tracked via an invisible tracking pixel; link clicks are tracked via link wrapping. You can see the full email engagement history on each deal and contact page.

mainEntity.name: Is Pipedrive secure and GDPR compliant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pipedrive is SOC 2 Type II certified and fully GDPR compliant. Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Pipedrive stores data in Google Cloud Platform data centers with locations in the US and EU. Enterprise plans add SSO/SAML, advanced permissions, audit logs, and custom data retention policies.

mainEntity.name: How does Pipedrive's pricing compare to HubSpot and Salesforce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pipedrive is significantly more affordable. Pipedrive Professional costs $49/user/month (annual billing). HubSpot Sales Hub Professional costs $90/user/month — nearly double. Salesforce Sales Professional costs $80/user/month. For a 10-person sales team, switching from HubSpot Pro to Pipedrive Pro would save over $4,900 per year.

mainEntity.name: Does Pipedrive support multiple currencies and languages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pipedrive supports over 15 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Russian, and Japanese. The interface language can be set per user. For currencies, you can set deals in any currency and Pipedrive converts them to your base currency for reporting. Each deal can have its own currency setting.

mainEntity.name: Can I automate workflows and repetitive tasks in Pipedrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pipedrive's workflow automation tool (Advanced and higher plans) uses a visual builder to create if-this-then-that rules. For example: 'When a deal moves to Proposal Sent stage, send a follow-up email and create a task to call in 3 days.' Advanced plans include up to 10 active automations; Professional and Enterprise have unlimited automations.

mainEntity.name: What is LeadBooster and do I need it?

acceptedAnswer.text: LeadBooster is a paid add-on ($32.50/month per company) that bundles a website chatbot, live chat, customizable web forms, and a meeting scheduler. It turns your website into a lead generation machine and captures contacts directly into Pipedrive. If you rely on website inbound leads and want faster response times, LeadBooster is a worthwhile investment.

mainEntity.name: Does Pipedrive offer a meeting scheduler?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — LeadBooster includes a built-in meeting scheduler that syncs with your Google Calendar or Outlook Calendar. Prospects can view your available time slots and book meetings directly. The scheduler automatically creates a new deal and contact in Pipedrive. The Advanced plan includes a standalone meeting scheduler without requiring the full LeadBooster add-on.
